podcast.body: Bill Danoff composed this song, which Emmylou Harris later performed on her 1975 album "Pieces of Sky." Harris used the song to articulate her profound grief over the death of Gram Parsons. "The composer of that song, by the way, is Bill Danop of the Starland Vocal Band."
